items.text: I am reaching across the aisle to pass a bipartisan bill to simplify the enrollment process and allow seniors to enroll in Medicare when it makes sense for them without facing penalties or having to go without coverage.

🚨 20 million Americans just signed up for health coverage through the Affordable Care Act. 

Trump and extreme Washington Republicans want to rip it away — including protections for pre-existing conditions like cancer, asthma, and diabetes. 

https://t.co/NsTyOdCuIV

Dreamers are Americans in every sense of the word. 

I applaud @JoeBiden's action today to ensure DACA recipients are able to sign up for health coverage through the Affordable Care Act.

https://t.co/fsueku4wAy

Abortion rights are on the ballot – even in New Jersey.

I’m proud to stand alongside Dr. Brandi, a NJ OB/GYN, who shared the dangers of a national abortion ban for patients and providers alike. Read more:

https://t.co/KzWpQevNtJ

The Navy taught me that you have three choices when things are tough — lead, follow, or get out of the way. I have always chosen to lead. This isn’t just an academic exercise. State leadership matters more than ever. And our party may not know it yet, but it’s counting on New Jersey to get this right. The Garden State is ready to lead. Will @DNC join us? 7/7

In New Jersey, a Black woman is almost 7 times more likely to die from maternity-related complications than a white woman. Black babies are more than 3 times more likely to die before their first birthday than white babies.

In a state with some of the best hospitals in the country, that’s unacceptable. As governor, I’ll double down on the good work of Nurture NJ and the Maternal and Infant Health Innovation Authority and work to address racial bias in our health care system, diversify our perinatal workforce, and improve health outcomes for Black women in NJ. #BlackMaternalHealthWeek

Sometimes I hear people say that reproductive freedom is not an issue in New Jersey or that we don’t need further protections for abortion rights. 

But just today, Trump rescinded guidance that prevented hospitals from turning away pregnant women who are in the midst of medical emergencies. MAGA extremists — including Jack Ciattarelli — are not done coming after our reproductive rights.
But there’s more: 410,000 New Jerseyans are estimated to lose their health insurance and 185,000 will lose food assistance. 3/10
450,0000 New Jerseyans will see their healthcare premiums DOUBLE, increasing costs by $4,200/year for a family of four. 4/10

.@Jack4NJ said if he was governor, he’d pressure the entire New Jersey delegation to vote yes on the Republican Price Hike bill.

@AndyKimNJ, you just voted in the Senate against this bill, which would take health insurance away from 400,000+ New Jerseyans — what do you think?

400,000 New Jerseyans will lose their health insurance.

450,000 more will see their premiums double.

200,000 will lose food assistance.

Utility costs will go up by hundreds of dollars for every New Jerseyan.

The SALT cap, which was set to expire, will be reinstated.

Hey @jack4NJ, the bill Trump championed and you cheered on is causing premiums to skyrocket for over 450,000 New Jerseyans.

We're in an affordability crisis. Are you still saying you can't come up with a single thing you disagree with him on?

https://t.co/ElSw9gGB1Y

There is no question that the State Health Benefits Program is broken and desperately needs reform. Our hard-working public servants simply cannot afford premium hikes of over 30%, and these costs are also putting intense pressure on municipalities' budgets and property taxes.

For 60 years, Medicare and Medicaid have been a lifeline for New Jersey’s families, seniors, veterans, and people with disabilities.

But now, Republicans like @Jack4NJ are gutting Medicaid coverage for New Jerseyans.

They’ll all face voters at the ballot box eventually — but New Jersey will hold Jack accountable in less than 100 days.

New Jersey lost 12k jobs in May and June. The labor market is crashing, prices are rising, & hundreds of thousands of New Jerseyans are about to lose their healthcare.

@Jack4NJ, how many more chances does your boss get before you start to put hardworking Jersey families first? https://t.co/TTjOtId3LE

Our healthcare system fails Black women every day — with deadly consequences. I’ve heard from women all over New Jersey who’ve lived this injustice.

As governor, I’ll change that by investing in doulas and midwives, expanding telehealth, and holding hospitals accountable. Black women deserve better.

If you’re one of the 500,000+ New Jerseyans who gets health insurance through Get Covered NJ, your premium is about to explode because of the Republican spending bill that @Jack4NJ wholeheartedly endorsed.

Jack Ciattarelli is already costing you.

https://t.co/Vj1mmk2Vey

Unions have given generations of families a fair shot at the American Dream — including my own. Labor Day is a chance to celebrate the generations of workers who fought for safer workplaces, fair wages, health care, and dignity.

While Washington Republicans are rolling back protections for unions, I’ll continue to stand with New Jersey workers to protect collective bargaining rights and invest in the people who built our state and keep it running.

The Trump economy has tanked job growth to its lowest point since 2020. Between the tariffs, rising unemployment, and soaring health insurance premiums, @Jack4NJ says we should feel this "pain" — all while pushing a 10% sales tax on food and clothes.

New Jersey CANNOT afford Jack Ciattarelli.

I was really disappointed to miss the Veterans Business Summit while in DC voting against cuts to healthcare and other services.

Thank you to Senator @VinGopal and my husband, Jason, a fellow Navy veteran, for going in my stead and talking about my plans to protect veterans from cuts to services and to make it easier to start and grow a small business.

New tech helps us connect — but every parent knows social media can devastate kids’ mental health, promoting poor sleep habits, loneliness, anxiety, and depression.

As governor, I’ll hold Big Tech accountable for the harm they’re causing New Jersey’s children and families. https://t.co/SaeQgtTisi

Under Trump’s budget bill: 300,000 New Jerseyans are going to lose coverage completely and an additional 450,000 New Jerseyans can expect their rates to go up. 

@Jack4NJ doesn’t “see this as a real problem.”

As social media algorithms change how we navigate our world, NJ’s youngest generation is facing an unprecedented mental health crisis — that’s why as governor, I’m introducing a bold plan to protect kids online, and stop Big Tech billionaires from putting them in harm’s way. https://t.co/eEfsp9SU7l

Trump and the Republican majorities in Congress had a choice between:
a) shutting the government down
b) working with Democrats to lower costs and prevent health insurance premiums from skyrocketing.

Guess which one they chose? This is precisely the extreme MAGA agenda that @Jack4NJ wants to bring to NJ.
